assets.prompt: Generate a production game background only, landscape 3:2, 1800x1200 composition, no UI and no text. Art direction: the original early-2010s Galaxy Empire mobile space strategy game. Crisp pre-rendered isometric 3D terrain, blue slate steel tiles, silver chamfered perimeter wall blocks, tiny yellow-black hazard stripes, cyan inset lights, dusty reddish-brown alien regolith. Orthographic camera at 35 degrees elevation; diamond tile edges run diagonally at about 30 degrees. This must be a DISTINCTIVE colony map with multiple fixed terraces, not one giant flat warehouse floor. Layout: upper-left and center-left is a large raised irregular blue metal industrial terrace filling x=10%-63%, y=10%-60%, with wide EMPTY areas for six buildings. Lower-left is a second raised blue metal terrace filling x=8%-49%, y=58%-89%, with wide EMPTY areas for four buildings. Right half x=65%-95% is an OPEN dusty reddish courtyard with room for five buildings, connected to left terraces by THREE short diagonal stone-and-steel stair ramps around x=60%,y=36%, x=56%,y=58%, and x=48%,y=79%. Terraces have thick segmented retaining walls on their near/lower edges, pipes at corners and sparse cyan runway lights. Along far left and upper edges only, sheer dark jagged cliffs with a few blue mineral seams. Right and lower edge fine dusty ground, tiny crater marks and rocks. Add a narrow service road weaving among zones; detail must be concentrated on terrace edges, leaving the interiors legible and EMPTY for building sprites to be overlaid. NO buildings, no ships, no turret towers, no silhouettes, no people, no labels, no construction pads painted in the center. The individual fixed foundation pads will be separate sprites. Original old game look, slightly stylized mechanical realism, fairly bright readable blue slate and ochre, clean small-scale prerendered art, not cinematic photorealism, not noisy rubble, not modern neon fantasy. Entire composition is ground, no sky or horizon. Consistent upper-left light; 2:1 diamonds on horizontal ground.

Create a single production transparent PNG sprite atlas with exactly 2 columns and 2 rows, four equal square cells, for the original early-2010s Galaxy Empire isometric base-building mobile game. Crisp old prerendered 3D game sprites, blue-grey steel, silver bevels, small cyan lights, small yellow-black hazard markings, upper-left lighting. Same orthographic 35-degree elevation camera as isometric buildings, floor footprint forms a wide 2:1 diamond. Each object completely isolated with true transparent surrounding pixels, at least 8% clear padding, aligned centered on the cell. No text or UI, no chart borders. Cell top-left: EMPTY CONSTRUCTION BERTH, a broad recessed octagonal diamond-shaped steel foundation, 4 small thick dark locking brackets around the edges, a dark empty inset center with one small glowing cyan triangular arrow pointing toward upper right; strong raised silver perimeter lip, practical panel seams. This is a vacant fixed building slot visible before construction. Cell top-right: OCCUPIED BUILDING FOUNDATION, same footprint and same dimensions, flatter steel center with no arrow and no brackets sticking high up, small embedded cyan corner lamps, diamond-shaped silver rim so a separate building can sit directly on top. Cell bottom-left: CONSTRUCTION IN PROGRESS FOUNDATION, same empty berth with a few short yellow supports and amber status lamps around the perimeter, center unobstructed. Cell bottom-right: SMALL DECORATIVE DEFENSE TURRET, a squat silver twin-barrel turret on a round blue-grey steel mount, compact and industrial, matching the original Galaxy Empire terrain-side turrets. Do not make any full-sized buildings; the first three cells are only low thin steel bases. True transparent background, no fake checkerboard, no cast shadow outside cell bounds.
